summary: +1 charm space for the rest of the run. It can be picked only once per run.
tip: Take it almost every time it shows up. Equip Megaphone first (+2) or bank it in Barathrum for a second trigger; with both it gives +4 slots.

synergies.why: Equipped when you pick it, the call triggers twice: +2 charm space, which also covers its own -1.
Bank this once-per-run call and discard Barathrum later for a second +1 slot (+4 total with Megaphone).
Phone abilities trigger twice for the whole run, so this gives +2 slots.
Released from Barathrum during the call that offers this, it fires this too, on top of picking it.
The extra slot pays for its -1 charm space.

summary: Doubles the Jackpot Pattern's current value (10 at base). It only pays on spins that land a full-grid Jackpot.
tip: Only for Luck/Jackpot builds (One Trick Pony, Ophanim Wheels, big Luck stacks). It doubles the current value, so raise the Jackpot first with I found a winning strategy!

synergies.why: Its guaranteed Jackpot pays double.
Every 999 forces a Jackpot on the next spin, each one worth double.
Adds +10 to the Jackpot first, so the doubling gains twice as much.
Its Luck bonus grows past 15, which guarantees a Jackpot when it fires.
Chain symbols scored in a Jackpot raise its value permanently, and this doubles the raised value.

assumptions: A full-grid Jackpot scores about 12 Patterns worth ~46x base in total, so the Jackpot Pattern itself (10x) is roughly a fifth of a Jackpot spin.

summary: Gives 5 Clover Tickets right away.
tip: Good early when a key charm is just out of reach; later, permanent stat calls usually beat a one-time 5 tickets. Megaphone makes it +10.

synergies.why: +5 held tickets is +1 Symbols Multiplier.
A third of the way to its next +1 Patterns Multiplier step.
A bigger pile at Deadline end means a bigger payout.
Pays for phone rerolls, each worth +1 Symbols Multiplier.
With no tickets from Rounds, 5 free tickets are worth much more.

summary: Every charm in the store right now costs 2 tickets less, until the store is next restocked.
tip: Pause the call and restock until the store shows charms you want, then take it: up to 8 tickets saved on 4 charms. Stacks with Fidelity Card, making cheap charms free.

synergies.why: The discounts stack to 3 tickets off each charm, so 1-3 ticket charms are free.
It becomes free: a clean +4 tickets.
That memory card's permanent 1-ticket discount stacks with this one.
A second trigger should take another 2 tickets off each charm.
More purchases for the same tickets, each raising its Ticket chance by 1%.

assumptions: Assumed the discount covers only the charms in the store when you take the call and ends at the next restock, including ones caused by charms like Cigarettes.
Assumed a Megaphone retrigger stacks a second 2-ticket discount.

summary: Instantly refills every Red Button charm to full charge.
tip: Worth it only when costly button charms are empty (Weird Clock, Number 1/2, Midas Touch). Barathrum can bank it for a second refill later; a lifeline with Overdose.

synergies.why: Refills all 12 charges: one more extra Round this Deadline.
Another Round of permanent Symbol value gains.
Another Round of yellow retriggers.
Button charms never recharge at Round end with this memory card, so a full refill is precious.
Bank it and discard Barathrum later for a second full refill.

antiSynergies.why: Button charms already refill before every spin, so this does nothing.

assumptions: Assumed only equipped Red Button charms are refilled, as with Car Battery.

summary: Gives a random equipped charm the Florid Trait: +3 Clover Tickets every time a Deadline ends, as long as that charm stays equipped.
tip: Pause the call and move charms you may sell into drawers so Florid lands on a keeper. It can overwrite a better Trait. Each traited charm also feeds The Collector.

synergies.why: A newly traited charm adds +1 Patterns Multiplier.
+3 tickets every Deadline keeps its Symbols Multiplier climbing.
Steady ticket income toward its 15-ticket steps.
Triggers twice, so up to two charms get Florid.

assumptions: Assumed a new Trait replaces any Trait the chosen charm already had (a charm holds one Trait).
Charms that cannot take Traits (instant charms, most charms spawned by calls) are assumed to be skipped.

summary: Gives a random equipped charm the Avid Trait: Symbols Multiplier +2 as long as that charm stays equipped.
tip: Huge early, when the Symbols Multiplier is small. Pause and drawer charms you may sell so Avid lands on a keeper; it can overwrite an existing Trait.

synergies.why: The traited charm also adds +1 Patterns Multiplier.
Turns Avid's +2 into a x2 Symbols Multiplier.
Triggers twice, so up to two charms get Avid.
Bank it and discard Barathrum later for another Avid charm.

assumptions: Assumed a new Trait replaces any Trait the chosen charm already had (a charm holds one Trait).
Charms that cannot take Traits (instant charms, most charms spawned by calls) are assumed to be skipped.

summary: Gives a random equipped charm the Ambitious Trait: Patterns Multiplier +1 as long as that charm stays equipped.
tip: The Patterns Multiplier starts at 1, so early this can double your coins. Drawer charms you may sell before taking it; it can overwrite an existing Trait.

synergies.why: Ambitious gives +1 Patterns Multiplier, and +1 more through The Collector.
Turns Ambitious's +1 into a x2 Patterns Multiplier.
Triggers twice, so up to two charms get Ambitious.
Bank it and discard Barathrum later for another Ambitious charm.

assumptions: Assumed a new Trait replaces any Trait the chosen charm already had (a charm holds one Trait).
Charms that cannot take Traits (instant charms, most charms spawned by calls) are assumed to be skipped.

summary: Gives a random equipped charm the Obsessive Trait: the last Pattern of every spin triggers one more time while that charm stays equipped.
tip: A spin with one Pattern pays double, and the extra trigger counts toward 3+/5+ Pattern charms (Pentacle, Rotten Pepper, Lucky Cat). Drawer charms you may sell first.

synergies.why: The extra trigger helps spins reach 5+ Patterns, growing its multiplier.
The extra trigger turns 2-Pattern spins into 3+ spins that grow its Luck.
Turns 2-Pattern spins into 3+ Pattern spins that pay your Interest.
A lone Pattern turned into your best symbol then scores twice.
A newly traited charm adds +1 Patterns Multiplier.

assumptions: Read "every last Pattern" as the final Pattern scored in each spin, so a one-Pattern spin pays double.
Assumed a new Trait replaces any Trait the chosen charm already had (a charm holds one Trait).

summary: Gives a random equipped charm the Gambler Trait: +1 free store restock every Deadline while that charm stays equipped.
tip: Weak on its own. Pick it for Shopping Cart (each held free restock is +2 Symbols Multiplier) or restock payoffs like Bell Pepper and Electricity Meter.

synergies.why: A free restock every Deadline that you can hold for +2 Symbols Multiplier.
Each restock spent adds +2 to its Luck bonus.
Each restock recharges a Red Button charm.
A newly traited charm adds +1 Patterns Multiplier.

assumptions: Assumed a new Trait replaces any Trait the chosen charm already had (a charm holds one Trait).
Charms that cannot take Traits (instant charms, most charms spawned by calls) are assumed to be skipped.

summary: Gives a random equipped charm the Speculative Trait: +3% Interest while that charm stays equipped.
tip: Small unless Interest pays during spins: Lucky/Chonky Cat and Token modifiers turn each +1% into real coins. Otherwise +3% on your deposit is minor.

synergies.why: Every 3+ Pattern spin pays your Interest, now 3% higher.
Its double-Interest payouts grow too.
Token symbols pay half your Interest each.
Stacks to 15% Interest (7 + 5 + 3).
A newly traited charm adds +1 Patterns Multiplier.

assumptions: Assumed a new Trait replaces any Trait the chosen charm already had (a charm holds one Trait).
Charms that cannot take Traits (instant charms, most charms spawned by calls) are assumed to be skipped.

summary: Cherries appear more often (+1 chance), permanently, making them the most common symbol.
tip: Commit only if Cherries carry your build (Golden Cherry, Wood, Shoe, Clicker); hard to undo. More Cherry lines also mean more Patterns per spin.

synergies.why: More Cherries on the grid means more Golden Cherries scored.
Doubling Cherry value pays off more once Cherries dominate the grid.
More Cherry Patterns for it to retrigger.
Cherries become the single most likely symbol, so they get +1 more.
Cherries are non-yellow, so its retriggers hit more Patterns.

antiSynergies.why: Halves the Cherry base chance, undoing much of this.

summary: Clovers appear more often (+1 chance), permanently: about twice their base rate.
tip: Commit only if Clovers carry your build (Golden Clover, Thimble, Sheep, AA Batteries); hard to undo. Pairs with I'm feeling lucky! to double Clover value.

synergies.why: More Clovers on the grid means more Golden Clovers scored.
Doubling Clover value pays off more on a common symbol.
More spins that score both Clovers and Bells, each worth 3 free restocks.
More Clovers carrying the Ticket modifier.
Clovers are non-yellow, so its retriggers hit more Patterns.

antiSynergies.why: Halves the Clover and Bell base chances, undoing much of this.

summary: Bells appear more often (+1 chance), permanently: about twice their base rate.
tip: Commit only if Bells carry your build (Golden Bell, Iron, Wheat, AA Batteries); hard to undo. Pairs with I'm feeling lucky! to double Bell value.

synergies.why: More Bells on the grid means more Golden Bells scored.
Doubling Bell value pays off more on a common symbol.
More spins that score both Clovers and Bells, each worth 3 free restocks.
More Bells carrying the Ticket modifier.
Bells are yellow, so its retriggers hit more Patterns.

antiSynergies.why: Halves the Clover and Bell base chances, undoing much of this.

summary: Diamonds appear more often (+1 chance), permanently: more than twice their base rate.
tip: Strong for Diamond and gem builds (Golden Diamond, Crystal Sphere, Eye Jar). Take value doublers like Gold and Diamonds... after it, since the gain grows with frequency.

synergies.why: More Diamonds on the grid means more Golden Diamonds scored.
Doubled Diamond value on a symbol you now see far more often.
+1 Diamond chance makes its 3-spin gem streak much more common.
More Diamonds carrying the Chain modifier.
More Diamond lines help form 4+ Patterns, and each raise hits a symbol you see often.

antiSynergies.why: Halves the Diamond, Treasure and Seven base chances.
Raised Diamonds can become your most valuable symbol and get banned.

summary: Treasures appear more often (+1 chance), permanently: more than twice their base rate.
tip: Strong for Treasure and gem builds (Golden Treasure, Ship, Eye Jar). Treasures are yellow, so Number 1 retriggers them too.

synergies.why: More Treasures on the grid means more Golden Treasures scored.
Doubled Treasure value on a symbol you now see far more often.
+1 Treasure chance helps keep its gem streak going.
More Treasures carrying the Ticket modifier.
Treasures are yellow, so its retriggers hit more Patterns.

antiSynergies.why: Halves the Diamond, Treasure and Seven base chances.
Raised Treasures can become your most valuable symbol and get banned.

summary: Sevens appear more often (+1 chance), permanently: three times their base rate, ahead of every other symbol.
tip: The core of a Seven build: follow with I'm gonna go "All In"! (x3 value), Golden Seven or 7 Sins Stone. Sevens then lead the odds, so Scratch and Hope boosts them too.

synergies.why: Tripled Seven value on a symbol you now see three times as often.
More Sevens on the grid means more Golden Sevens scored.
Permanent +1 Seven chance toward 7-Seven spins.
One +1 Seven call makes Sevens the most likely symbol for good, so it adds +1 more.
Its +2 Seven chance for a Deadline stacks on top.

antiSynergies.why: Halves the Diamond, Treasure and Seven base chances.
Sevens are usually your most valuable symbol, so they get banned.

summary: Doubles the current value of Clovers and Bells, permanently.
tip: It doubles the current value, so take it after gilding or other raises (Golden Clover/Bell, Ace of Clubs). Best when Clovers and Bells score a big share of your coins.

synergies.why: Doubles the Clover value you have grown; take it after gilding.
Doubles the Bell value you have grown; take it after gilding.
Its permanent Clover and Bell raises get doubled.
More Clovers on the grid make the doubling pay more.
More Bells on the grid make the doubling pay more.

antiSynergies.why: Halves the Clover and Bell base chances, undoing much of this.

assumptions: Doubles the current value, not the base value (per the wiki).

summary: Doubles the current value of Diamonds and Treasures, permanently.
tip: It doubles the current value, so take it after gilding or other raises (Golden Diamond/Treasure, Ace of Diamonds). Best in gem builds.

synergies.why: Doubles the Diamond value you have grown; take it after gilding.
Doubles the Treasure value you have grown; take it after gilding.
Its permanent Diamond and Treasure raises get doubled.
Doubled Diamond and Treasure values, paid 4x on lone gem Patterns.
More Diamonds on the grid make the doubling pay more.

antiSynergies.why: Halves the Diamond, Treasure and Seven base chances.

assumptions: Doubles the current value, not the base value (per the wiki).

summary: Triples the current value of Sevens, permanently.
tip: Little use while Sevens are rare (about 7% of symbols); huge after I didn't hurt anybody..., Seven Picture or Golden Seven. Raise first, triple after.

synergies.why: Sevens become the most common symbol, so tripling them pays off.
Triples the Seven value you have grown; take it after gilding.
Tripling Seven value after gilding multiplies the gains.
Lone Patterns turn into Sevens, now worth triple.
Its permanent +7 Seven raises get tripled if you take this afterwards.

antiSynergies.why: Halves the Diamond, Treasure and Seven base chances.
Tripled Sevens are surely your most valuable symbol, so they get banned.

assumptions: Triples the current value, not the base value (per the wiki).

summary: Adds base value to every Pattern of 3 or fewer Symbols (HOR, VER, DIAG and the 2-symbol ones). The first pick doubles them.
tip: Strong early, when most coins come from 3-symbol lines. Each repeat adds only +1x base; the Sacred call I want to address some stuff doubles them instead.

synergies.why: Add first, then double: the Sacred x2 on small Patterns multiplies the raised value.
Its 2-symbol Patterns get +0.5 each too.
A lone Pattern is usually a 3-symbol line, now worth more and turned into your best symbol.

summary: Adds base value to every Pattern of 4+ Symbols (HOR-L, HOR-XL, Zig, Zag, Above, Below, Eye, Jackpot). The first pick doubles them.
tip: Best with Luck or forced big Patterns (Nose, Little Star, Disc C, Eye Jar). Take it before I can't quit now! or the Sacred x2 on big Patterns, which double the raised value.

synergies.why: Forces Above/Below, whose value rises by 7 each.
Its forced HOR-XL is worth +3 more.
Its forced Zig and Zag are worth +4 more each.
Raises the Eye it forces by 8.
Add first, then double: the Sacred x2 on big Patterns multiplies the raised value.
Raise the Jackpot by 10 first, then double it.
